response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with strong testing culture and some high-throughput systems exposure, but falls well short of the core requirements: he has under a year of professional C++ experience versus the required 8 years, and his career centers on web/product development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than large-scale cloud compute infrastructure. He also lacks demonstrated formal technical-leadership experience mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers, making him a weak fit for this specific role despite his breadth.
strengths: Low-latency distributed systems experience at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic handling millions of HTTP requests per second
Strong engineering-practices background (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) plus active mentoring via workshops and courses
Long-running ownership of an open-source platform (GISCollective) deployed on Kubernetes, showing end-to-end project ownership
concerns: Roughly 7 months of professional C++ experience versus the required 8 years
Career focus is web/product full-stack development, not cloud compute platforms or hardware/storage infrastructure
No formal technical-lead role managing priorities, deadlines, or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers on record

key_factors.factor: Broad senior engineering and mentoring track record
